description: If you're searching for a capable, proven full-size truck, this 2017 RAM 1500 Crew Cab Big Horn for sale at Turbo Motors in Taylor, MI is worth a serious look. Equipped with the legendary 5.7-liter HEMI V8, an 8-speed automatic transmission, and full 4WD capability, this truck is ready for work, weekends, and everything in between. At 160,326 miles, it's a high-mileage option priced for buyers who want real truck value in Wayne County without the new-truck payment.About This 2017 RAM 1500 Crew Cab Big Horn The 2017 RAM 1500 Crew Cab Big Horn is one of the most popular configurations RAM sells, and for good reason. The Crew Cab body gives you a full four-door layout with generous rear-seat room  enough for a full family or a crew of workers riding to the job site. The 5½-foot bed hits a practical sweet spot, offering solid hauling capacity while keeping the overall truck length manageable in parking lots and tight job sites.With over 160,000 miles on the odometer, this is a truck that's been used the way trucks are meant to be used. Buyers in Taylor and across Wayne County who understand how well-built modern RAM trucks age will recognize the value here. The 5.7-liter HEMI is one of the most durable truck engines on the road, and many examples run well past 200,000 miles with proper maintenance.2017 RAM 1500 Performance and Engine The HEMI V8 in this 2017 RAM 1500 produces 395 horsepower and 410 lb-ft of torque in stock form. That's enough muscle to tow up to 10,640 pounds when properly equipped  a figure that competes with anything in the half-ton segment. Whether you're hauling a loaded trailer up I-75 or navigating muddy worksites outside of Taylor, this engine delivers with authority. 8-Speed Automatic Transmission Paired to the HEMI is RAM's 8-speed TorqueFlite automatic, a transmission widely praised for its smooth shifts and intelligent gear selection. It keeps the engine in its power band on the highway for better fuel efficiency and provides strong, responsive downshifts when you need to pass or climb. For a V8 truck of this size, real-world highway fuel economy in the low-to-mid 20s is achievable under the right conditions.4-Wheel Drive Full 4WD capability makes this RAM 1500 a true four-season truck for Michigan drivers. Southeast Michigan winters are no joke  snow-covered roads in Taylor, icy overpasses, and slushy highway conditions demand real traction capability. With 4WD engaged, this truck handles it with confidence.RAM 1500 Big Horn Features and Interior The Big Horn trim sits in the heart of RAM's lineup  above the base Tradesman but below the Laramie  and it delivers a comfortable, well-equipped interior without the luxury price tag. Big Horn models typically include:RAM's Uconnect infotainment system with a touchscreen display, Bluetooth connectivity, and available navigation. The Crew Cab configuration provides heated front seats on many builds, a folding rear seat for extra cargo flexibility, and a center console deep enough to double as a mobile office. Power windows, locks, and mirrors are standard, and the overall cabin materials punch above the trim's price point.The 5½-foot bed includes a spray-in or drop-in bedliner on most working examples and is compatible with a wide range of tonneau covers, toolboxes, and bed extenders  making it easy to customize for your specific hauling needs.RAM 1500 Reliability and Ownership The 2017 RAM 1500 has earned a strong reputation among truck owners and industry analysts alike. The 5.7-liter HEMI engine has been in production for decades and is known for its longevity when maintained with regular oil changes and cooling system service. The 8-speed automatic transmission, when serviced at recommended intervals, is equally durable.Common ownership considerations at higher mileage include monitoring the water pump, thermostat, and serpentine belt  all routine maintenance items for a truck this age. The front suspension components, including ball joints and tie rods, are worth inspecting on any high-mileage truck used in Michigan's pothole-heavy road conditions. Overall, the RAM 1500 of this generation is considered one of the more reliable domestic half-tons, and a well-maintained example at 160,000 miles still has significant useful life ahead of it.Why Buy From Turbo Motors in Taylor, MI Turbo Motors is located in Taylor, in Wayne County, Michigan  right in the heart of one of the state's most truck-friendly communities. Buyers throughout Downriver know that finding a quality used truck at a fair price takes local knowledge and an honest approach. Turbo Motors focuses on working-class vehicles for working people, and this RAM 1500 is exactly the kind of truck that fits that mission.When you shop at Turbo Motors, you're dealing directly with a local operation that understands Wayne County buyers  not a large corporate dealership where you're just a number. The team is straightforward about what each vehicle is, and they're ready to walk you through this RAM 1500 in person.

When paired with a 6-speed manual transmission and a BMW Individual paint finish, it becomes something far more exclusive. This 2013 BMW M3 is finished in BMW Individual Atlantis Blue Metallic, a color produced in exceptionally limited numbers and widely regarded as one of the rarest finishes ever applied to the E92 chassis. The Individual Atlantis Blue finish changes character depending on the light, ranging from a rich metallic blue to subtle turquoise undertones, accentuating the E92's muscular fenders and carbon fiber roof. Combined with the Competition Package wheels and lowered stance, the result is one of the most visually distinctive E92 M3s BMW ever produced. Fast Out Of State Shipping Available..What the reviews say..What Edmunds.com says..Volkswagen's smallest SUV is a big deal. The 2024 Taos packs plenty of modern tech and safety features into a tidy package. It also has excellent passenger and cargo space. Overall it's one of the most well-rounded and family-friendly offerings in the class. Coming off a debut a couple of years ago, the 2024 Volkswagen Taos is the brand's smallest and least expensive SUV. Think of it as the little brother to the Volkswagen Tiguan. But even though it's small, the Taos still has a roomy interior and many technology and driver assist features that come standard on most Taos trim levels. The Taos is also one of the quicker models in its class thanks to its 158-horsepower turbocharged 1.5-liter four-cylinder engine. This little Volkswagen SUV isn't so little on the inside. With 27.9 cubic feet of cargo space behind the rear seats alone, the Taos is one of the roomiest models in its class. If you're standing at the rear hatch and in need of more space, the release levers on the seats are just within reach. The Taos' rear seats also have a 60/40 split, folding mostly flat. Parents of small children will also appreciate well-positioned top anchors and ease of fitting a car seat, making the Taos one of the most family-friendly options in the class. How does the Taos drive? We were surprised to find the Taos, one of the larger SUVs in this diminutive class, is also one of the quickest. The Taos handles around corners quite impressively as well, with well-controlled body roll and accurate steering. The climate control is easy to use and effective at distributing air flow to the entire cabin. How's the interior? The interior is one of the best in the class, from the ease in which you can step in and out of the large door openings to the generous passenger space. The Taos almost feels like a class size up compared to its competition. When it came to styling the Taos, VW didn't bother reinventing the wheel. It looks very much like a scaled-down Atlas, which is to say clean and kind of rugged.

What this vehicle includes:               Convenience Cruise control maintains a preset vehicle speed; automatically increasing or decreasing throttle to maintain that speed.Powertrain and Mechanical All-wheel drive supplies power to both the front and rear axles all the time. Power is instantly redirected by the center differential to the wheels with greater traction when slip is detected.  Unlike full-time 4-wheel drive systems, there is no 2-speed transfer case for 4WD Low operation. In normal driving conditions, automatic full-time 4-wheel drive directs power to one axle, or 2-wheel drive. When the primary axle senses wheel spin or slippage, some or all available torque is automatically transferred to the secondary axle. No driver input is required. The system may or may not have 4WD-Low capabilities. The engine configuration is four cylinders arranged in a straight line. Variable valve control allows the lift, duration and/or timing of the intake or exhaust valves to be altered while the engine is in operation.Safety and Security The vehicle is equipped with a camera that displays an image of the area behind the vehicle on an interior display.
